Six roofing jobs, each laid properly.

Pitched roofs are the specialist area. Domestic and commercial work.

  • Concrete tile roofs

    An extensive range of concrete roof tiles in many sizes and styles, with plenty of options to suit most budgets.

  • Man made slate roofs

    A cost effective choice for repairing an existing roof or covering a new pitched roof.

  • Natural slate roofs

    A robust roof covering that deflects the most extreme weather. Welsh slate is a speciality.

  • Leadwork repairs and replacement

    Traditional and modern leadwork, done to a high professional standard.

  • Gutter repairs and replacement

    New PVC guttering systems that protect your property from the harshest weather.

  • Fascias and soffits

    Fascia and soffit replacement at competitive prices.

Also: pitched roof repairs, roof and gutter cleaning, insurance work and general roof repairs.
